description: Every section: target IDList, LinkInfo with a VolumeID, all five StringData fields, and nine ExtraData blocks including the unassigned 0xA000000A signature
notes: The 0xA000000A block is deliberate: MS-SHLLINK 10.0 leaves that signature unassigned, and an unknown signature must round-trip as Unknown rather than failing the parse. IconIndex is negative (a resource ID, not an index) and the hotkey is Ctrl+Alt+A.
